channel.title: The Pick and Roll Podcast
channel.description: Steven Toroni and Al Hunter are some of the sharpest minds in Fantasy Basketball. The guys break down the latest DFS slates every episode and provide season-long analysis all year long. You can catch Al's DraftKings articles every day during the NBA season - covering the DFS slates. Steven has covered the Lakers in Los Angeles and written Fantasy Basketball for Fantrax and Rotoexperts. He is currently the host of the Hot Take Fantasy Football Podcast.

item.title: Episode 7: Industry Draft Recap with Adam King of Fantrax
item.description: For episode 7 of The Pick and Roll, Al and Steve are joined by Adam King of Fantrax.com to discuss their results from a 20 man fantasy expert draft that they all participated in this offseason. On top of covering this expert draft that hosted some of the biggest names in fantasy basketball, they cover all the big news leading up to opening night of the NBA season. Including Zion Williamson's injury, Dion Waiters' suspension, Jaylen Brown's new contract and more. Learn more about your ad choices. Visit megaphone.fm/adchoices

PLUS - since this episode was recorded on Kobe Bryant's birthday - the guys talk about their favorite Mamba moment. Learn more about your ad choices. Visit megaphone.fm/adchoices
